# The Yard Thai Cuisine

> Women-owned Thai restaurant in Agoura Hills, CA serving authentic Thai cuisine with fresh ingredients and traditional recipes.

The Yard Thai Cuisine is a neighborhood Thai restaurant at 5889 Kanan Rd, Agoura Hills, CA 91301. Call (818) 532-7272 to order or inquire about catering. Online ordering is available via Toast.

## Pages

- [Home](https://theyardthai.com/): Restaurant overview, featured dishes, and location highlights
- [Menu](https://theyardthai.com/menu): Full menu of Thai appetizers, soups, curries, noodles, rice, and desserts
- [Catering](https://theyardthai.com/catering): Catering for corporate events, private parties, and special occasions

## Contact & ordering

- Phone: (818) 532-7272
- Address: 5889 Kanan Rd, Agoura Hills, CA 91301
- [Order online](https://www.toasttab.com/local/order/the-yard-thai-cuisine-5889-kanan-rd)

- Fri–Sat: 11:00 AM–2:30 PM, 4:00 PM–8:30 PM
